name: ILDC facts-only InLegalBERT sequence-classification baseline

model.head_initialization: AutoModelForSequenceClassification with a new randomly initialized two-label classification head

input.text_source: shared extract_case_facts output only; no retrieval or evidence lookup

selection_protocol: Evaluate and save after each epoch on validation accuracy only. Load the best validation checkpoint, then evaluate the test split once. Do not tune after test evaluation.
